title: Read it backwards
prompt:
Think of a six-letter word for something you get for doing good work. Write it backwards and you get a word for something you'd find in a desk.

What is the thing in the desk?
hints: Which six-letter words mean a prize, or something given for good work?
Which of those words ends in a letter that could start the name of a part of a desk?
Which six-letter word for a prize starts with R?
solution:
**Drawer.**

REWARD, something you get for good work, reads DRAWER backwards: the part of a desk that slides out.

The search is quickest from the reward side. There are only a few six-letter words for a prize (reward, trophy, bounty, payoff), and only one of them reverses into a word at all. Words that make a different word when reversed are called semordnilaps, which is *palindromes* spelled backwards.
